name: Unfold
alt: Angular colored planes open around a smaller central faceted shape.
description: An enclosing form opens to reveal a vivid center. The folds now perform an action: revealing something valuable.
connection: Collecting carries a possibility that is resolved by the draw. This is a metaphor for anticipation and revealing the result, not an NFT changing its permanent artwork.
assessment: More interpretive. Some viewers may see a crystal or a crest before they see a prize; the focal shape and opening need testing.

name: Award
alt: A faceted polygonal upper form with two tapered folded ends beneath it.
description: The upper medallion and two short ribbon ends establish a recognizable award silhouette. Folded facets give that familiar cue its own treatment.
connection: Rewards is centered on prizes and the winning holder’s right to claim. Recognition and winning are the primary associations; the artwork does not encode the contract rules.
assessment: The clearest reward cue in this round. Its next challenge is a more distinctive outline and cleaner seams, without losing the award reading.
